horoscopes.horoscope: At times it is a good thing to be under pressure, because it brings out your potential to the fullest. You will outsmart all your colleagues in the work you do. However, results may not match your expectations. Ganesha advises patience as results don’t come overnight. You may sideline love life but your sweetheart will understand your responsibilities and forgive you. You may feel that you are not keeping your partner happy. However, your sweetheart knows your instinct. You are likely to get emotional support from your loved one. Today, you will be investing all your energy in making things work for you at work front. You will be going ahead with proper planning yet chances of doing backbreaking hard work are there. Due to the same, you may feel stressed. Today is an auspicious day to invest more money in your business, rather than just worrying about it. If you want to expand, investment would be necessary. It’s more about work and less about money today. Career progress seems to be the only thing on your mind today, foresees Ganesha. Progress depends on taking the right decisions at the right time. That is what you will exactly do, says Ganesha. You will expect others to work hard, just like you.

This is a great day for expressions your ideas and feelings. Ganesha urges you to open up and share hopes and concerns, dreams and aspirations with your others. Romance is in he air. You could be flying deliriously high on the wings of love, in the company of your sweetheart. You are likely to spend some intimate moments with children and youngsters. Warmth and intimacy will highlight all the time spent in the company of others. Your family may be in the mood to give you a pleasant surprise. Things will go in your luck. This is the time to celebrate with near and dear ones. Moral support from your better half will boost your confidence, feels Ganesha. Ganesha does not find you facing any major health issue today. There will be positive changes in your thinking, because of which you will also see many positive changes in your life. You will be in ‘power saving mode’ today. Ganesha feels you will have to be smart in order to earn really well today. This is what you are going to learn today. On the whole, it’s a day in your favour on the financial front. Luck supports you in everything you do. Some new projects may come your way. Your confidence will help you make decisions effectively in meetings and communicate with new people in and outside the country. You will be happy with the way your destiny is heading.

A fantastic day to enter into all kinds of partnerships. A day to bond with your close friends, open joint accounts, strike deals, and make plans for a bright future, says Ganesha. You will be at the top of your game in almost everything you do. Some of you, who want to go for further studies, may take a well-informed decision today. Love life will remain peaceful. Confidence will make your relationship strong. You are giving quality time to your sweetheart. Now, you are looking for a long-term relationship. A romantic conversation is likely to stimulate your passion. Ganesha foresees that communication may cause problems, hence try to be polite at work. Try to complete the incomplete task before the deadline. Your mood may be spoiled due to work load. But health won’t be affected. You may enjoy some great time with family. Owing to financial pressures, Ganesha feels you may also not be able to perform well in your work. You are advised to shun all worries and try to work towards a better tomorrow. Finishing all the work in time will be quite easy. The only hurdle seen is the mood swing which might make your day seem longer. It is an average day with no peculiar events. You should not be away from your responsibilities, reminds Ganesha.

Today, you may find yourself marooned in a sea of emotions, and the tides of turmoil will keep on getting stronger as the day progresses. However, such dire circumstances bring out the best in you, and you will be able to wade through the storm with nothing but patience on your side. A great news is awaiting on the love front. You are feeling lucky with your sweetheart. You are planning different things as every day is just passing by. For those of you who are already in a relationship, it’s time to start thinking about marriage, suggests Ganesha. Ganesha feels that you are likely to feel low today due to stress at work. Few people might try to bug you, hence it’s the best to stay cool or else some conflict may arise. Health front may draw your attention today. You will not have any major problems in managing your money because you will be quite pragmatic today, feels Ganesha. This kind of approach towards finances will help you save money. You should agree to everything your superiors say in order to avoid arguments today. Ganesha feels that you will take the backseat at the workplace. You need not worry as this is a temporary phase. You will get back your energy soon.

Some promises are like whispers in the wind — never meant to be realised. Today holds something similar, in that you shall be so close and yet so far from what you desire most. Ganesha advises you to be a generous winner and a graceful loser. Remember, every day is not Sunday; also, you cannot win each time. Lower your expectations in order to avoid disappointments. Wait for the winds to change — it won’t take long. Romance is in the air and you will enjoy it to the fullest. You seem to take the centre-stage in the relationship. You tend to be bold in front of your sweetheart and are likely to attract him/her to stimulate desire. The end result will be satisfaction. Ganesha foresees that this may be a sensitive period for you. You are likely to feel tensed due to an arguments with a closed one. The professional front looks good. You need to become health conscious now before your un-planned diet starts affecting you. Ganesha says that while you are going to practice economy today, you will feel like spending money if you had more. Better days are coming ahead, predicts Ganesha – so remain hopeful. You may feel like putting in the extra effort, making it a hectic day at the office. Disagreement is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. You should avoid conversations with superiors as they may end in an argument. It’s time to control your temper.

Don’t dilly-dally when it comes to matters of health, says Ganesha. You look lean and mean to take on those old wounds today. But peace and prosperity are the flavours of the day. Ganesha advises you to invest time in fun and entertainment today – just to get those batteries charged. The desire to be with someone close to heart will help you finish the work on time. You may be with someone who would like to inspire you and bring a smile on your face. You will also like to ensure a smooth relationship. Ganesha predicts that this phase may feel emotionally delicate. Differences with someone close could leave you feeling a bit stressed. On the brighter side, your professional life appears stable and promising. However, it’s important to start paying attention to your health, as an irregular diet may soon begin to take a toll. Ganesha foresees that today will be in your favour as far as finances are concerned. If you have invested money in mutual funds or equity market, today you are likely to get good returns. You may not be interested in handling simple routine tasks as you are in a mood of development and inventions. You will try something innovative in your vocation. You may welcome change if possible. Your experimental attitude will bring some positive outcomes, foresees Ganesha.

If ever there was a time when that industrious nature of yours was to listen to your conscience, it is today. Call it a positive day to embark upon new business adventures, particularly for freelancers. It is mighty hard to go wrong when you listen to your inner voice and back it up with zeal. The hard work of the morning and the pressure of the afternoon will give way to pleasure in the evening. Just enjoy what you do, says Ganesha. Some domestic responsibility may demand attention. Be careful and learn to support your loved one as he or she needs your help. Joint decision-making or financial planning will be on your mind today. You should come to the final decision after careful considerations. Ganesha says that career front may concern you as you have been taking things very easy until now. Health looks good, but you may get dragged away by some old memories. You are not much in a mood to socialize. Try to stay relaxed now. Ganesha feels that in financial matters you will be able to guide people in your friends circle today. They will believe in your advice and will be benefited too. You may even give a talk on the art of saving money. You will handle work like a true professional today. You should not expect more from your work, says Ganesha. Accuracy and sincerity in work will demand your attention. Be careful since there can be misunderstandings through email communications, reminds Ganesha.

Better get down to serious business if you want to reap the benefits of your past actions. You are liable to treat subordinates as equals when deciding the best course of actions to achieve your goals. A golden favourable day for you, says Ganesha. You may tend to dominate your life partner. However, Ganesha says that you should be creative and try to impress your sweetheart. Your love life will be safe if you can give your partner space. Maintaining a harmonious relationship with your spouse will make you happy. Ganesha says that you should do things that make you happy as this way you can always improve your health and mood. This day indicates rise in income as well as rise in expenditure also. Carrier front may draw you immediate attention towards them. You shall spend lavishly and will not regret it later. Ganesha feels that this is going to be a day with less potential to earn and average potential to spend money. You are likely to spend on home decor. You will enjoy a good time in the office. The pending tasks will be completed today. The routine work will get managed effectively. You will be confident in your approach, says Ganesha. Things will be in your luck since you have learned a lot from your mistakes.

Zoom in on complicated problems and solve them with style, says Ganesha. Don’t fret over problems; instead concentrate on ways to solve them. Your day will get even better when perhaps, news from an overseas friend reaches you. Balancing work and family will be a little difficult as family too will demand more time today. You need to pay your attention to your family and loved one. Your partner may feel less fortunate with you. Being in touch and satisfying his/her needs will be the challenge. This day looks very promising for you as lots of growth and opportunities are foreseen in your way soon. Hence little more efforts at work may do wonders. Health needs to be handled with care now. You may enjoy your day with your family. Today you are going to taste financial success. Your efforts that have gone in anything productive, will not go in vain and will fetch you satisfactory returns. Still, you will wish to add to your income. You will try to be punctual in whatever you do today, says Ganesha. As you will wish to do your best in every task, you might have to work hard and even stay back at the office till late. Your hard work is likely to bring results in the future.

Drag yourself out of the house, do some shopping, or better still, appoint an interior designer. You are very likely to move into a new house very soon, foresees Ganesha. This, of course, may also eat into your savings and force you to be thrifty by the end of the day, but you won’t regret this once-in-a-while extravagant outing. It’s all for a reason, after all. Love life is in full swing. You may want to surprise your partner with a gift. You love to value freedom and let your partner give space. However, the bond is likely to be so strong that your mate will come to you. Professional front needs your immediate attention. This is not a favorable day for investments. Ganesha advises, you to postpone important tasks or decisions. It will be better if you avoid travelling today. Health is likely to affect your routine life. Try to go with the flow. Your rewards today will be in good proportion to the efforts that you have invested, feels Ganesha. Today you will be able to plan good strategies for finances and business. You seem to be full of energy. The energy will boost your confidence in work and thus benefit your career. Career change is not your plan now. You will be focused and maintain a long-term career. You will be careful in decision-making so that even a single action does not go in vain.

A romantic liaison is headed towards you. Quite naturally, you don’t want to be caught dead in a ratty old tee. Today, you want to keep everyone happy and amused, both at home and at work. And you manage wonderfully, says Ganesha. You are having some challenges in your love life. Understanding your loved one may take some time. However, you need to pay attention to your sweetheart. Being honest and truthful with your partner will maintain a good bonding, says Ganesha. Ganesha predicts that personal front may immediately draw your attention as a family member is likely to face some health issue. Those involved in business may see stronger profits coming their way soon. Try to invest your time in planning work now. Ganesha feels that today you may be a bit worried about long term finances. There will be money coming in shortly. Do not judge your financial strength by today’s planetary positions. Ganesha wants you to be extra cautious in the workplace today. Also, it would be advisable for you to maintain a low profile. You have to face some tough challenges and may have to take the important decisions under a critical circumstance, feels Ganesha.

Being a graceful loser is just about as important as being a generous winner, for success does not come by every day. Lowering your expectations will help steel you against disappointments today. There are indications you will embark on a pleasure trip with your soul mate, says Ganesha. You will feel the sweet smell of love when you return home being tired. You should not worry since Ganesha says that your love life will be calm and peaceful. Your partner will fill your heart with joy and happiness. Expect a jovial conversation with your loved one tonight. Ganesha foresees that opportunities may come your way now. You may need to work extra hard and get work notices at workplace. You’ll face a lot many obstacles, but you will overcome them all. Health looks good. Try to focus on your dreams now. Today is a favourable day to organise get-togethers and throw parties, even if it costs a bomb. Ganesha feels that the day is good and filled with sufficient money leading to contentment. You will be lucky today. Ganesha feels that hard work always pays off. Professional life will be smooth. The major projects will get done on time. Hence today your hard work will get a lot of appreciation from your colleagues, feels Ganesha.
